title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
**Description**
---------------

**Product Marketing Manager**
-----------------------------

Do you want to be part of creating a safer world? Without thinking about it, you meet us in your everyday life – at home, in transit, and at work. We are at the airport, where you commute, where you work, play and shop. Diverse in our offering, our customer outreach and in our mindset, Gunnebo Entrance Control is leading the transformation of the security business through digitalisation and connectivity for the continuous developments of smart entrance control.

If you are passionate about being part of an exciting transformation journey working with a global, multi-cultural and highly motivated organisation, this is the opportunity for you. Gunnebo Entrance Control is small enough to see your ideas come to fruition, and big enough to realise your career goals.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Product Marketing Manager is responsible for planning and delivering global product marketing activities that support business growth, product adoption, and successful product launches across the Entrance Control portfolio.

This role will lead the execution of product launch programmes, develop compelling product positioning and messaging, create sales enablement materials, and ensure consistent communication of product value propositions across all markets.

This role is critical to ensuring the successful delivery of the company's product launch roadmap, supporting revenue growth, and maintaining consistent product marketing activities during the maternity leave period.

The role has one direct report – 3D Graphic Designer, who is based in Czechia..

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Product Launch Management**

* Develop and execute global product launch plans for new products and product upgrades.
* Coordinate launch activities with Product Management, Sales, Regional Marketing teams, and external agencies.
* Create launch toolkits, sales presentations, and supporting marketing materials.
* Monitor and report on launch performance and key success metrics.

**Product Marketing**

* Develop product positioning, messaging, and value propositions.
* Create and maintain product literature, brochures, data sheets, and sales tools.
* Support the creation of case studies, customer success stories, and product-related content.
* Ensure product information remains accurate and aligned across all customer touchpoints.

**Digital Content & Campaigns**

* Manage product content across websites and digital platforms.
* Deliver product-focused email marketing, social media, and digital campaigns.
* Support lead generation and awareness-building activities for new product introductions.
* Work with creative resources to develop product imagery, videos, renderings, and other marketing assets.

**Sales Enablement**

* Create and maintain sales support materials.
* Provide marketing support to regional sales teams.
* Coordinate product marketing assets through the company's asset management platforms.
* Support product and sales training initiatives.

**Events & Exhibitions**

* Support planning and execution of key industry exhibitions and customer events.
* Develop exhibition content, product displays, and supporting promotional materials.
* Coordinate launch activities linked to major industry events.

**Key Relationships**

* Product Management
* Global and Regional Sales Teams
* Regional Marketing Managers
* Engineering and R&D Teams
* External Agencies and Suppliers

  

**Requirements**
----------------

**Skills & Experience**

**Essential**

* Experience in product marketing, product management, or B2B marketing.
* Proven experience managing product launches and go-to-market activities.
* Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience developing marketing collateral and digital content.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver to deadlines.

**Desirable**

* Experience within manufacturing, technology, security, or industrial sectors.
* Experience supporting international markets.
* Knowledge of digital marketing and marketing automation tools.
* Experience coordinating trade shows and exhibitions.

**Personal Attributes**

* Highly organised and detail-oriented.
* Commercially minded with a customer-focused approach.
* Proactive and able to work independently.
* Strong collaborator with the ability to influence across functions.
* Adaptable and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.

**Contract Details**

* **Contract Type:** Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Cover)
* **Duration:** Approximately 12 months
* **Location:** India, hybrid (x2 days in the office)
* **Travel:** Occasional international travel may be required.

**About us**
------------

The Gunnebo Group is a global leader in security, offering innovative products and services to protect and control the flow of people, and to safely secure valuables. Through our businesses and customers in retail, public transport, public and commercial buildings, industrial and high-risk sites and banking, we operate worldwide through our 3,400 employees, 25 country locations and 10 production facilities. title: SDR
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a driven and organized Sales Development Representative (SDR) to manage

and qualify incoming sales leads and convert them into qualified sales opportunities.Your

primary responsibility will be to own incoming leads from the moment they enter the sales

pipeline — contacting prospects quickly, understanding their requirements, qualifying the

opportunity, scheduling product demonstrations, and consistently following up to move

prospects through the sales process.You will act as the first point of contact for prospective

customers and play an important role in ensuring that genuine opportunities do not get lost due

to delayed responses or inadequate follow-up.

Key ResponsibilitiesIncoming Lead Management – Primary Responsibility

● Handle incoming leads generated through the website, marketing campaigns, referrals,

WhatsApp, calls, partnerships, and other lead-generation channels.

● Contact new leads promptly and ensure defined response-time SLAs are consistently

met.

● Conduct initial discovery calls to understand the prospect's company, current processes,

pain points, requirements, and reason for evaluating the product.

● Qualify leads based on defined criteria such as customer profile, use case, company size,

requirement, decision-making process, urgency, and buying intent.

● Identify the relevant decision-makers and stakeholders involved in the purchase.

● Clearly communicate the product's core value proposition and determine whether there is

a potential fit.

● Schedule product demonstrations with qualified prospects and coordinate with the

relevant sales team member.

● Ensure prospects attend scheduled demos through confirmations, reminders, and

rescheduling where required.

● Conduct persistent and structured follow-ups with prospects through calls, WhatsApp,

email, and other appropriate channels.

● Re-engage leads that have gone cold or have stopped responding.

● Maintain complete and accurate records of every lead, interaction, follow-up, qualification

status, and next action in the CRM.

● Ensure no qualified lead is lost because of missed follow-ups or poor lead management.

● Provide clear context and qualification notes when handing qualified opportunities to the

salesperson responsible for closing the deal.

Outbound Prospecting – Secondary ResponsibilityWhen inbound lead volumes permit, the SDR

will also support new business generation by:

● Researching and identifying potential target companies.

● Identifying relevant decision-makers within target accounts.

● Conducting outbound prospecting through phone, email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and other

appropriate channels.

● Qualifying outbound prospects and scheduling meetings or product demonstrations.

● Following up with prospects until they are qualified, disqualified, or moved into a nurture

pipeline.

What We're Looking For

● 1–3 years of experience in B2B sales, inside sales, business development, telesales, or

SaaS sales.

● Strong verbal and written communication skills.

● Comfortable speaking with business owners, operations teams, HR teams, and senior

decision-makers.

● Strong questioning and listening skills with the ability to understand a prospect's actual

business problem.

● Excellent follow-up discipline — you should be comfortable contacting a prospect

multiple times across different channels.

● Ability to differentiate between genuine sales opportunities and low-intent enquiries.

● Organized and capable of managing a large number of leads simultaneously without

losing track of follow-ups.

● Comfortable working with defined targets and conversion metrics.

● Familiarity with CRM systems and sales tools is preferred.

● Professional communication skills in English and Hindi; additional languages are an

advantage.

Career GrowthStrong performers can progress into roles such as Senior SDR, Account Executive,

Business Development Manager, or Sales Manager, based on performance and demonstrated

ability to manage the sales process.

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

description:
Manager – Social Impact \& NGO Partnerships

*Ideacraft \& Brandict \| Corporate Merchandise* ***Sustainability***  *Social Impact*

About Ideacraft \& Brandict

Ideacraft is a technology\-driven B2B digital marketplace and sourcing ecosystem for branded merchandise, corporate gifting and employee engagement solutions. We are building a more organized, transparent and scalable way for companies to source, manage and deliver merchandise through technology, automation and a strong supplier network. Our solutions span brand stores, on\-demand gifting, automated gifting, custom kitting and bespoke merchandise.

Brandict is our Dubai\-headquartered private\-label merchandise brand, created for the global promotional products market. It brings together product excellence, sustainability and social impact as three core pillars of every product story. Brandict works with distributors and corporate merchandise partners internationally, with a focus on thoughtful design, responsible materials and products that can communicate a meaningful impact story through QR\-led storytelling.

Across both businesses, we want social impact to be embedded into commerce rather than treated as a one\-time CSR activity. Our objective is to build credible NGO partnerships, support measurable initiatives and enable customers to see how their purchases can contribute to people, communities and a better tomorrow.

The Role

We are looking for a hands\-on Manager – Social Impact \& NGO Partnerships to build and manage the social\-impact ecosystem for Ideacraft and Brandict. The role will identify credible NGOs and social enterprises, evaluate their processes, structure partnerships, coordinate impact programs and convert verified outcomes into authentic stories that can be shared with our customers. This is an execution\-oriented role requiring regular field interaction, strong documentation and the ability to work closely with internal marketing, sourcing, operations and leadership teams.

Key Responsibilities

**Identify, meet and evaluate NGOs, foundations, social enterprises and community organizations aligned with education, hunger, livelihood, environment, inclusion and other relevant causes.**

**Conduct basic due diligence on prospective partners, including governance, registrations, utilization of funds, program capability, transparency and evidence of impact.**

**Build a curated network of credible partners across India and, progressively, other markets relevant to Ideacraft and Brandict.**

**Design practical impact programs linked to orders, products or defined campaigns, with clear contribution mechanics, beneficiaries and measurable outcomes.**

**Coordinate with NGO partners on implementation, timelines, documentation, photographs, beneficiary stories, utilization records and periodic impact reporting.**

**Create a simple internal framework to track contributions and outcomes so that customer\-facing impact claims remain accurate, traceable and defensible.**

**Work with marketing and creative teams to convert verified impact into concise website, catalogue, QR\-code and campaign stories without exaggeration or tokenism.**

**Support the Brandict QR\-story proposition by developing authentic social\-impact narratives that can be associated with relevant products and programs.**

**Coordinate employee volunteering, donation drives or community initiatives where these strengthen the overall impact program.**

**Prepare monthly/quarterly dashboards for management covering partners, funds deployed, beneficiaries/outcomes, active initiatives, documentation status and next priorities.**

**Maintain complete records of MOUs, approvals, partner documents, reports and impact evidence; escalate compliance or reputational concerns promptly.**

What We Are Looking For

**3–7 years of relevant experience in CSR, NGO partnerships, social impact, sustainability, foundations, development sector or a comparable role.**

**Strong field orientation — comfortable visiting NGOs and project locations, speaking with beneficiaries and independently validating execution.**

**Good understanding of NGO operations, documentation and basic CSR/compliance processes; ability to distinguish genuine impact from marketing claims.**

**Strong written and verbal communication, stakeholder management and reporting skills.**

**Structured, ethical and detail\-oriented, with a high level of ownership and sensitivity while working with communities and partners.**

**Ability to operate in an entrepreneurial environment and build the function from the ground up.**

Success in This Role

Success will mean building a trusted network of impact partners, establishing a disciplined process for selecting and monitoring initiatives, creating measurable and well\-documented outcomes, and ensuring that every impact story communicated by Ideacraft or Brandict is credible, human and supported by evidence.

**Purpose of the role: Make social impact a measurable part of every relevant order and product story — not an afterthought.**
